name: device_claim_failures
description: Counter rows for failed pairing-code claims, which bound guessing per person and per company.
lifecycle: Inserted on each failed claim; counted over 15 minutes and deleted one day later.

columns.Meaning: Company the failed claim targeted; immutable (tenant key).

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A failure belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A failure belongs to an existing principal.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_claim_failures_company_id_id_key ON public.device_claim_failures USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE INDEX device_claim_failures_company_time_idx ON public.device_claim_failures USING btree (company_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX device_claim_failures_principal_time_idx ON public.device_claim_failures USING btree (principal_id, occurred_at)
